page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory allocated per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the ecs.c2.xlarge does not feature integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host. This resource density makes the instance qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring predictable compute performance and moderate memory capacity. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, and medium-sized databases that rely on network-attached storage.
